subject: Re: Kickoff: pruning toolkit — April status + a threshold-scheduling risk
body:
Hi both,

Status: pilot team 1 is training with magnitude pruning at 80% target sparsity; Giannis's tooling strips the mask and threshold variables from the trained graph cleanly, so deployed checkpoints carry no pruning overhead. Wei has team 2 integrating this week.

Comparison grid is half done. Early read: gradient-based pruning wins at high sparsity — at 90%, it holds a 1.1-point quality advantage over magnitude on the recommendation model — but is roughly even at 70-80%.

The risk: the pruning schedule's threshold updates interact badly with team 1's learning-rate warm restarts. Twice we saw the effective sparsity snap from 60% to 78% within 500 steps after a restart, destabilizing training. Workaround is freezing threshold updates for 1k steps around each restart; Vera is folding a proper fix into the hparams defaults so pilot teams don't need to know this footgun exists.

Hyun
